translation.name: Ri C'ac'a Trato ri Xuben ri Dios Quiq'uin ri Vinek

book.name: SAN JUAN
book.title: Ri ruc'aslen ri Jesucristo ri tz'ibatel can roma San Juan

content: Ri xbanatej pa jun c'ulubic chiri' pa Caná
Y pa rox k'ij, ri chiri' pa tinamit rubini'an Caná ri chiri' pa Galilea, c'o c'a jun c'ulubic xbanatej. Y ri María ri rute' ri Jesús, can c'o c'a chuka' chiri' chupan ri c'ulubic ri'.
Y ri Jesús e rachibilan ri rutijoxela', xe'oyox c'a chuka' chupan ri c'ulubic ri'.
Jac'a ri ruya'al-uva xa xq'uis yan chanin chupan ri c'ulubic ri'. Y ri María ri rute' ri Jesús, xapon c'a apo riq'uin ri Jesús y xberubij chire: Man jun chic tz'uj ruya'al-uva quiq'uin.
Pero ri Jesús xubij c'a chire: ¿Achique c'a ri navajo'? Roma ri nu-hora xa c'a man jani tapon, xcha' rija'.
Y ri rute' ri Jesús xubij c'a chique ri ajic'a': Vi c'o ri xtubij ri Jesús chive, can tibana' c'a, xcha' chique.

Y ri chiri' ec'o c'a vaki' nima'k tak cucu' (k'e'l), e banon riq'uin abej. Ri israelitas yalan yecucusaj cucu' (k'e'l) que tak ri', roma chupan cucu' (k'e'l) que tak ri' niquiya-vi ya' ri nic'atzin chique richin ri ch'ajch'ojirisanic,
can achi'el c'a ri nichilabex chique roma ri qui-ley. Y ri cucu' ri' (ri k'e'l ri'), cajquej ciento vasos ya' quipan.
Y ri Jesús xubij chique ri ajic'a': Que'inojisaj chi ya' re cucu' re' (re k'e'l re'), xcha' chique: Y ri ajic'a' can que vi ri' xquiben. Can xequipulisaj c'a can ri nima'k tak cucu' ri' (k'e'l ri').
C'ari' ri Jesús xubij c'a chique ri ajic'a': Vacami tipaja-el juba' y tic'uaj chire ri pa'el chuvech re nimak'ij re', richin tuna'. Y ri ajic'a' can xquiben-vi ri xubij ri Jesús chique.

Y ri pa'el chuvech ri nimak'ij ri', tok runa'on chic ka chi yalan jebel ri ruya'al-uva ri', xroyoj c'a ri achijlonel chupan ri c'ulubic ri'. Ri pa'el c'a chuvech ri nimak'ij ri', man c'a retaman ta acuchi petenek-vi ri ruya'al-uva ri'. Xa can xe c'a ri ajic'a' ri xepajon ri e etamayon.

Y tok ri achijlonel xapon c'a, ri pa'el chuvech ri nimak'ij richin ri c'ulubic ri' xubij c'a chire: Tok c'o jun nimak'ij quere', conojel c'a vinek ja ri ruya'al-uva ri utz niquiya' nabey, y tok xa yojtajinek chic ri pa quichi' ri ec'o pa nimak'ij, roma q'uiy chic ri quikumun, niquiya' c'a jun ruya'al-uva ri man can ta utz. Pero rat xa man que ta ri' xaben. Rat xa c'a ri' xabevelesaj-pe ri ruya'al-uva ri utz, xcha'.

Re xuben c'a ri Jesús chi xuben ruya'al-uva chire ri ya' ri pa c'ulubic pa Caná ri chiri' pa Galilea, jac'ari' ri nabey milagro ri xuben. Y re jun milagro re', can xuc'ut c'a chi rija' can c'o-vi ruk'ij-ruc'ojlen.
Y ri e rutijoxela' can xquicukuba' c'a quic'u'x riq'uin.
Tok can c'achojinek chic c'a can ri c'ulubic, ri Jesús rachibilan ri rute', ri e rach'alal y ri rutijoxela' xebe pa tinamit Capernaum. Y xec'oje' c'a ca'i-oxi' k'ij chiri'.
Tok ri Jesús xerokotaj-pe ri c'ayinela' pa rachoch ri Dios
Y can nakaj chic c'a ri k'ij richin ri quinimak'ij ri israelitas, ri rubini'an pascua,
k'ij tok yecamisex ri tak carne'l. Romari' ri Jesús can xbe c'a pa tinamit Jerusalem,
richin ri nimak'ij ri'.
Y ri chiri' chuva-rachoch ri Dios ri c'o pa Jerusalem, ri Jesús xeberila' c'a c'ayil tak váquix, c'ayil tak carne'l, y c'ayil tak palomas. Y xeberila' chuka' jaloy-ruvech mero e tz'uyul ri chiri'.
Ri Jesús, can xe c'a xerutz'et, xuben c'a jun ruch'aybal riq'uin colo' y xerokotaj-pe

conojel. Xerokotaj c'a pe cachibilan ri quicarne'l y ri quiváquix ri chiri' chuva-rachoch ri Dios. Y chique ri jaloy-ruvech mero, xuc'akala' c'a can ri qui-mero chiquivech y xerutec'mayila' can ri qui-mesas.
Y chique ri c'ayil tak palomas xubij c'a: Que'ivelesaj-el re' vave'. Y man tiben chire ri rachoch ri Nata' Dios, jun c'ayibel, xcha' ri Jesús.

Romari' ri rutijoxela', can chanin c'a xoka' chiquic'u'x ri jun tzij tz'ibatel chupan ri ruch'abel ri Dios. Ri tzij c'a ri' nubij: Nupaxij vánima ri itzel ye'ajin chubanic ri vinek chupan ri avachoch,
nicha'.
Y jari' tok ri achi'a' ri can c'o-vi quik'ij chiquicojol ri israelitas, xquibij chire ri Jesús: ¿Achique c'a ri yatiquir nac'ut chikavech
richin chi can niketamaj chi c'o uchuk'a' pan ak'a' richin xe'avokotaj-el ri vinek vave'? xecha'.
Y ri Jesús xubij c'a chique: Tikasaj c'a pan ulef re jun jay re', ri can richin ri Dios, y yin pan oxi' k'ij xtinyec chic jun bey,
xcha'.

Y jac'ari' tok ri achi'a' ri can c'o-vi quik'ij chiquicojol ri israelitas, xquibij chire ri Jesús: Re jun jay re', cavinek-vaki' juna' xquiben ri kate-katata' chirij richin xquipaba'. ¿Yatiquir cami c'a rat napaba' pan oxi' k'ij? xecha' chire.
Pero ri jay ri xubij ri Jesús chique ri vinek ri', ja ri mismo ruch'acul.

Y romari', tok ri Jesús xcamisex chuva ri cruz y pa rox k'ij xbec'astej-pe, ri rutijoxela' xoka' c'a chiquic'u'x re jun tzij re xubij chique ri achi'a' ri can c'o-vi quik'ij chiquicojol ri israelitas. Y xcuker c'a quic'u'x riq'uin ri ruch'abel ri Dios ri tz'ibatel can
y riq'uin ri ch'abel ri e rubin can ri Jesús.
Ri Jesús retaman ri c'o pa tak cánima ri vinek
Y chupan c'a ri k'ij tok c'o-ka ri Jesús ri pa Jerusalem roma ri nimak'ij pascua, can e q'uiy vi c'a vinek ri xeniman. Re vinek re' xquinimaj tok xequitz'et ri milagros ri xeruben
chiquivech.
Pero ri Jesús man c'a xucukuba' ta ruc'u'x quiq'uin ri vinek ri', roma rija' can retaman-vi ri c'o pa tak cánima conojel vinek.
Y man nic'atzin ta c'a chire chi c'o ta jun ri nibin chire achique rubanic ri quic'aslen chiquijujunal ri vinek; roma rija' can retaman-vi achique c'a ri c'o pa tak cánima.
